scope: Research only; no production settings, ledger or entry rules are changed. Fixed-clock entries isolate exits and do not reproduce MARS selection or portfolio returns.
universe_reason: All 15 names in the pre-existing data/history_15stock panel, chosen before fetching this study's intraday prices. Fixed current-name sample; survivorship and large-cap selection limit generalization.
provider: Upstox V3 historical-candle, minutes/5, timezone-bearing bar starts; bounded calendar-month requests; no daily substitution
entry_rule: Buy at the stated bar open with adverse slippage, integer fee-inclusive quantity. Two independent observations per stock/session, not overlapping portfolio capital. Features use only bars completed before entry; exits cannot use pre-entry highs/lows.
validity: Require every regular-session 5m bar from 09:15 to 15:25, coherent finite positive OHLC, finite nonnegative volume, unique aligned timezone-bearing timestamps, completed and calendar-verified sessions. Invalid or missing sessions remain excluded with reasons for every symbol/date. Do not forward-fill. Require 20 consecutive prior verified full sessions for target calibration and 14 daily true ranges; require 14 completed 5m true ranges before entry.

trail_rules.current: Activate after peak exceeds slipped entry; trail 1% below observed peak; hard stop retains priority.
trail_rules.net_activation: Keep original 1% trail distance; activate only when peak * 0.99 covers entry plus both order fees and assumed sell slippage. Once active, never loosen; price gaps can still lose money.
trail_rules.atr_lock: Distance is max(2 * pre-entry ATR14 of completed 5m bars, 0.2% of entry). Activate only when peak minus this distance covers net break-even. Once active, never loosen; no guarantee against gaps.

target_rule: Past-session target is min(current completed-5m-ATR target, entry * (1 + median maximum upside from the same clock to 15:25 over exactly 20 prior complete sessions))). Floor at the quote needed for net break-even plus 0.1% of entry. Freeze target and all ATR values at entry; target calibration never sees the current session after entry.

costs.historical_plan: Counterfactual selected Basic tariff, not proof of historical account charges
costs.orders: One buy and one full sell per sample; existing partial-exit accounting separately remains covered by Goal05 tests

execution_notes: First two scenarios assume continuous monotone segments between named OHLC points, with market-trigger fills and adverse slippage, stop/target priority and gap fills at open. They are sensitivity paths, not mathematical bounds or known tick ordering. Third observes completed-bar closes only on 30-minute clock boundaries and fills those observations; all scenarios exit at the 15:25 open. No fills at an earlier stop through a gap. No liquidity/queue guarantee.

selection.metric: Maximum worst-scenario mean net return in bps across the three execution scenarios at 5 bps per side, train only; tie break by declared arm order
selection.validation: Evaluate the single train-selected arm without switching to another winner. Preserve failure, even if another arm looks better on validation or holdout.
selection.seal: Write protocol, dataset and runner hashes, selected arm and train/validation results before evaluating holdout; refuse changed hashes. Once opened, this holdout is consumed and cannot be reused for retuning.

evidence_thresholds.candidate_requirement: Non-baseline selected arm, positive net expectancy and positive paired improvement in validation and holdout under every execution scenario at 5 and 15 bps; day-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound for paired holdout gain above zero; report 30 bps stress separately.

report: gross return, fees, slippage, net expectancy
target hit rate and time in trade
daily grouped realized drawdown, not mark-to-market portfolio drawdown
promotion: No automatic apply operation. Even a statistical pass only nominates a candidate for full-strategy replay and forward paper validation with actual quote cadence, score/danger/sector exits, market impact and owner approval. Existing thresholds stay in force. Daily/multi-day performance is outside this intraday study.

amendment.reason: Source call-path correction: engine scan attaches signal_history to pick.history, and _target_for reads it; Goal04 intraday signal history is completed 5m. No training, validation or holdout returns evaluated before correction. Acquisition completed; coverage inspection only.
